review:
A 6x7 Megaways grid with a row of reel modifiers above it. Each spin, modifiers can offer cash up to 100x, multipliers up to 100x, max ways, an extra wild reel, or replacing every non-winning symbol.

Wilds on reels 2 to 5 expand over their reel and fire the modifier above. Four to six scatters give 12 to 16 free spins with four modifiers every spin. Every wild has a visible consequence. Up to 10,000x, 96.55% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
